sources.title: Zero-Shot Retrieval for Scalable Visual Search in a Two-Sided Marketplace
sources.snippet: Visual search offers an intuitive way for customers to explore diverse product catalogs, particularly in consumer-to-consumer (C2C) marketplaces where listings are often unstructured and visually driven. This paper presents a scalable visual search system deployed in Mercari's C2C marketplace, where end-users act as buyers and sellers.
